title: Expedition 69 Axiom Mission 2 International Space Station Hatch Closure - May 30, 2023
description: Axiom Mission-2, the second private astronaut mission to the International Space Station, undocked from the orbiting laboratory with its crew of Peggy Whitson, John Shoffner, Ali Alqarni, and Rayyanah Barnawi on May 30. Prior to undocking, the crew entered their Dragon spacecraft Freedom for the trip back to Earth and a splashdown off the coast of Florida.
